decisions.statement: This table is written out from the companion pages rather than by hand.
These bytes are the last good build rather than the bytes the generator emits today.
The generator that wrote these bytes cannot run today.
Nothing in akasha reproduces these bytes.
These skills are one unbroken run of the whole table's order.
A skill moved between runs breaks every build hash saved.

definition: one run of companion skills, in the order the whole table names them
